chunks: Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ayyub, from Abdul Momin Al-Ansary, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

Indeed, Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, has granted the believer three characteristics: honor in the world and the Hereafter, success in the world and the Hereafter, and prestige in the chests of the unjust.
ai.seo_question: What are the three characteristics granted to the believer by Allah according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the comprehensive nature of divine favor for the believer, encompassing both temporal success (falaj) and spiritual dignity (izz) across both realms of existence. Notably, it includes 'mahabah' (awe or prestige) specifically within the hearts of the unjust, a concept often linked to the authority of the Ahl al-Bayt and the faithful who command respect even from their adversaries. This triad underscores the holistic victory of the believer, where spiritual integrity translates into tangible social and cosmic influence.
